thread:
sam: Heads-up: after toggling the rollup mode for endpoint /v1/embeddings p50 vs p95 in us-east look inconsistent. p50 improved but p95 got worse. link: https://console/redwood/d/embeddings-latency
nora: Which panel? the endpoint summary or region rollup?
sam: region rollup -> merged-percentiles. individual host p95s are unchanged.
yang: Are we doing any sample-tag filtering before merge? We recently added a 'warmup=true' tag for new route warmups but the backend doesn't always mark it in the alias row.
sre-ethan: We store t-digests with sample_count in the meta. There was a bug where alias rows created during route alias reconciliation had sample_count=0 for a few seconds. The merge function treats 0 as 1.
sam: I tested locally: include a zero-count digest and a small fast digest and the merged p50 goes down while p95 moves up.
nora: Then we should: 1) make merge skip sample_count<=0; 2) add ingestion assertion to prevent alias rows with 0.
deploy-bot: routing-policy v4 -> us-east deployed at 08:20 UTC :white_check_mark:
yang: Also add a console annotation when routing-policy rollouts include warmup traffic. Makes diagnosing easier.
sre-ethan: Action items:
- yang: dashboard annotation + synthetic-rate time series (ETA EOD)
- sam: collect sample ids and attach to issue #10920
- nora: submit PR to ignore zero-count digests in merge (ETA 2h)
- infra: enforce warmup tag in job config
sam: I rolled back the panel to raw-sampled while we fix the merge. p95 looks consistent now.
nyang: opened PR #2321 with unit tests.
sre-ethan: good, let's monitor.
sam: thanks.
